thread:
sophie: heads-up - saw a nasty perf regression on MQA path when paged-KV uses block_size=512. seq_len=2048 workloads jump ~2x p50 latency on A100 runs. attaching quick flame snapshot in a follow-up (short).

mike: ugh. did this show up after the kernel-picker refactor?

sophie: looks like it. before refactor: gqa/paged-kv picked gqa-paged-v1 for these shapes. after refactor kernel-picker prefers generic mqa-stride-opt for MQA and falls back to slow path because kv layout now reports as "paged:512:stripe-4".

anya: can you paste the perf numbers?

sophie: pasted top of trace: 
```
seq=2048 batch=4 model=gqa-mqa
before: p50=45ms p95=120ms tokens/sec=340
after:  p50=92ms p95=240ms tokens/sec=165
kernel-switch at step ~120 => change from gqa-paged-v1 -> mqa-stride-opt
GPU occupancy: before ~78% after ~42%
mem copy stalls up x2
```

chris: looks like the mqa-stride-opt kernel isn't optimized for the paged KV stripe layout. It probably assumes contiguous KV pages per head. The layout metadata needs to be part of the kernel selection key.

mike: agree. current picker keys: {arch, dtype, seqlen_bucket, mqa_enabled}. It doesn't encode kv_block or stripe_count. we should add kv_layout.signature -> include block_size and stripe_count.

infra-bot: perf-run 2026-03-15T10:02:01Z completed: run_id=perf-5221, artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/perf-5221/flame.html

anya: quick experiment idea: add kv_layout to picker and add a candidate mapping: if kv_layout.paged && block_size==512 => prefer gqa-paged-v1 family for MQA as well. But need tests across seq=512/1024/2048.

mike: also consider sequence-length-aware pathing: for seqlen<1024 we can use small-block kernels, for seqlen>=1024 use page-aware kernels that prefetch multiple blocks. The autotuner should evaluate per-(model,arch,kv_layout,seqlen_bucket).

sophie: I'm worried about explosion of autotune state. but we can bucket seqlen coarsely: <512, 512-1536, >=1536. add kv_block as {256,512,1024} and stripe_count {1,4}. that's manageable.

chris: can we do incremental autotune: only run when new (model,kv_layout) combo seen in prod, and cache results. Also add a safety fallback: if tokens/sec drops >20% compared to cached baseline, revert picker and emit alert.

mike: +1. proposed quick sweep command for infra to run on perf runners: 
```
export AUTOTUNE_CANDIDATES="gqa-paged-v1,gqa-paged-v2,mqa-stride-opt"
./perf_sweep.sh --model gqa-mqa --arch a100 --batches 4 --seqlens 512,1024,2048 --kv-blocks 256,512,1024 --stripe 1,4 --out perf-5222
```

sophie: scheduling the sweep now on perf runner 07. will attach results. planning to also add a temporary rule in picker: prefer gqa-paged-v1 for kv_block==512 + seqlen>=1536 while we evaluate.

anya: when you push that rule, add telemetry tag so we can find rollouts that hit the rule. also log which kernel was chosen and why (picker_reason).

infra-bot: scheduled perf-sweep run_id=perf-5222 on runner-07. ETA ~35m.

chris: another micro-optimization: when page-aware kernel chosen, enable async prefetch of next N blocks (N=2) and increase prefetch_budget for seq>=1024. That reduced stalls in earlier experiments.

mike: good call. add a feature flag: runtime.enable_async_kv_prefetch and runtime.async_kv_prefetch_n. default off until we validate.

sophie: ok i'm pushing the picker change to include kv_layout.signature (small PR) and a short-term rule for block=512+seqlen>=1536. will link PR here.

mike: thanks. after sweep completes let's reconvene and decide permanent autotune buckets and whether to ship async prefetch.

sophie: thanks all. attaching flame and nvprof snippets below for trace-120: 
```
# flame summary (trace-120)
gqa-paged-v1: 48% compute, 8% copy
mqa-stride-opt: 22% compute, 34% copy, 18% idle
```

sophie: (link) s3://redwood-perf/perf-5221/trace-120-flame.html

anya: noted. I'll start a short eval harness to validate generation quality on gqa-paged-v1 for MQA (make sure output hasn't drifted).

chris: ping me if autotuner needs new hooks. I can add kv_layout emission to runtime metrics.

sophie: will do. will post results once perf-5222 finishes. :coffee:
